Messages.Author: Kimmo Lindman
Messages.Body:
Let's try again...

Soul Stealing Card Text:
Only usable when a vampire you control burns a vampire controlled by your
prey. Your vampire gains an amount of blood equal to half of the burned
vampire's capacity (round down). (Ignore excess blood.)
Errata:
The normal version can only be used as an action modifier (card text). Add
Superior: As above, and this card can also be played as a combat card.
[RTR 19960124]
Ruling:
Soul Stealing cannot be used if a vampire is burned as a result of a
political action, such as Tradition Upheld. [RTR 19960124]

Question:
Can my vampire play inferior Soul Stealing when he burns one of my prey's
vampires in torpor by diablerie?

Fortune Teller Card Text:
Retainer with 1 life. During your minion phase, you may look at one card
picked at random from your prey's hand.

Question:
When I have 7 Fortune Tellers in play I get to look 7 cards at random from
my prey's hand. Can I pick these 7 cards all at the same time or do I have
to pick the cards one by one and allow my prey to shuffle his hand each
time before I pick the next card?

Hope you can help me with these questions!

Kimmo

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:

> Errata:

Yes.

> Fortune Teller Card Text:
> Retainer with 1 life. During your minion phase, you may look at one card
> picked at random from your prey's hand.
>
> Question:
> When I have 7 Fortune Tellers in play I get to look 7 cards at random from
> my prey's hand. Can I pick these 7 cards all at the same time or do I have
> to pick the cards one by one and allow my prey to shuffle his hand each
> time before I pick the next card?

One by one. You get to look at one card at random, and you get to do it
seven times (once for each FT).
